peelout.name: Peel Out
peelout.sub: Tap to flap. Through the vines and over the crates; the vat is waiting.

snake.name: Banana Snake
snake.sub: Tap the side you want to turn to. Eat jelly, grow a peel, never bite it.

invaders.name: Banana Invaders
invaders.sub: Drag to slide, tap to throw a peel. The flies come down in rows.

pong.name: Banana Pong
pong.sub: Drag your peel. Spinner is on the other side, and he gets better.

stack.name: Banana Stack
stack.sub: Tap to drop the crate. What hangs over is lost. Perfect drops grow it back.

start.invaders: tap to throw, drag to slide

startKeys.snake: press an arrow key to go
startKeys.invaders: S to throw, A and D to slide
